actual_defects_fixed: Independent real PostgreSQL reproduced two GA rows committed with the same grr_id. New unique receipt_id and same-transaction assignment reject the second, preserving its SIGNING reservation and active slot.
Independent real PostgreSQL reproduced read_execution changing with TimeZone. UTC function configuration now gives exact equality across UTC and Asia/Shanghai.
Original 128-character valid GA key overflowed transition limit when suffixed. Supervisor now derives fixed 70-character domain-separated SHA256 keys over complete GA bytes, operation and stage.

pre_fix_run.meaning: Assertions confirmed actual two defects, not product correctness.

review_findings: Installer creates only four new empty private tables and functions; target marker/existing control domain required. No Gate, issuer, Root, generation or execution-binding row is installed.

Original Root lock is acquired before runtime row lock; CAS/unique attempt idempotency and one active budget charge serialize conflicting operations. DUPLICATE is historical recovery with authority NONE.
Send states precede CREATE/START; exact container bound for observation/STOP. UNKNOWN and revoked/expired attempts retain active slot, with exact discovered-container cleanup only.

Immutable GA raw/digest/decision/terminal result and append-only events protected; independent generation rollback checked against history. Service role has callable functions, no direct table access; all four tables RLS.

Supervisor requires trusted executable ports, two fresh checks around durable Intent readback, new SQL send acknowledgment, deadline and live START watchdog; no automatic redispatch after DUPLICATE/UNKNOWN.
This source still depends on real accepted tool-side verifier, current SQL bridge, fixed Docker/watchdog and evidence ports. Mock functions passing tests are not those accepted ports.
installation_conditions: Coordinator may install this exact SQL atomically into uscrdifznmlvczcekqpw under the approved same-domain bootstrap preparation. No execution_binding/current rows, signatures, GA or grant activation included.
Read back new four tables empty/RLS and exact function bodies/ACL; compare previous Root table/function metadata and existing Root state without altering them.

Provisioning and actual execution require separately accepted exact controller/Profile/Gate/source/issuer/proof/Root-generation/budget/currentness bindings. Current enumeration seeds no applicable Gate; no synthetic G1 may be promoted.
remaining_runtime_conditions: Full original GA/GRR Schema, exact Gate version/digest, all credentials/NA/purpose/Audience/signatures and signed generation transitions are external trusted-host obligations; SQL storage shape does not prove them.

Real current state must be fetched before each effect; SQL transaction cannot atomically fence later external Docker execution. Actual host-check timing and crash/STOP behavior need real observation for this supervisor.
GRR signing, unique decision/outbox flow and actual stopped evidence must be independently validated before commit. No recorded PASS from fixture booleans.
Budget initial values must conservatively cover actual previous usage when provisioning; reservations charge full window/128MiB and never auto-refund unknown work.
Root expiry/revocation and current issuer configuration remain authoritative; no historical snapshot as a future lease.
not_accepted: No controller qualification, usable GA/GRR, PQUAL result, Entry or Slice A acceptance.
No production permissions, models/paid actions, arbitrary host commands or existing Root configuration rewrite.
